## Summary

- Refresh Phase 0 stable-release aggregate/current-main audit to `origin/main` commit `518f6f8512d7f47d36d444557ab841ea0d5e0b83` after PR #664.
- Record the open-PR snapshot containing this aggregate refresh PR (#662), refresh merged PR coverage through #664, and explicitly exclude closed/unmerged or open aggregate-only PRs from the merged range.
- Add the after-664 blocked evidence bundle with PR snapshots, workflow snapshots, aggregate/module summaries, release-claim fail-closed exit captures, and checksums.
- Refresh the open-gates coverage audit metadata without closing any runtime gate.

## Verification

- Remote Phase 0 checks run `34107468232` completed successfully for commit `518f6f8512d7f47d36d444557ab841ea0d5e0b83`, including protocol, android, and macos jobs.
- Remote HarmonyOS run `34107468153` and iOS engineering run `34107468276` completed successfully for the same commit.

- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew --no-daemon testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.StreamClientOwnershipBoundaryContractTest` -> pass.

- `make phase0-module-ownership-gate PHASE0_MODULE_OWNERSHIP_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-664-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-module-ownership-summary.json` -> pass summary written.

- `PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> captured exit 2, fail-closed because release-claim mode requires expected source commit.
- `PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=518f6f8512d7f47d36d444557ab841ea0d5e0b83 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-664-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> captured exit 2, fail-closed because aggregate remains blocked.
- `make evidence-tools-test` -> 1409 tests OK.
- `shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-664-current-main-gate-blocked/SHA256SUMS` -> all OK.
- `git diff --check` -> OK.
